priority_findings.finding: Final production completion records the full planned quantity while build_item_rows sums all closed production sessions. Earlier partial quantities are therefore added again.
27 tests fail because the completion policy now requires planned quantity, while older file fixtures omit it. Confirm the mandatory-planning contract and align imports, validation, and fixtures.

26 full-run failures hit end <= start. Immediate sequential UTC reads on this Windows interpreter often return the same timestamp. These failures receive a separate rerun using the original SQLite settings.

Legacy end-to-end fixtures conflict with current registration eligibility, approval-recipient fields, validation responses, export filename and replacement approval behavior. Drone import also returns no batch in one test.
Three sample-request notification tests and the legacy Finance-owned PM-assignment test conflict with newer workflow behavior; review expectations before changing business rules.
